method.purpose: Two-stage association (high-score detections first, then low-score detections for unmatched tracks) with a constant-velocity Kalman filter and Hungarian assignment.
method.ref: Y. Zhang et al., ByteTrack: Multi-Object Tracking by Associating Every Detection Box, ECCV 2022, arXiv:2110.06864; A. Bewley et al., SORT, ICIP 2016, arXiv:1602.00763.

highScore.purpose: Detections at or above this score take part in the first association.
highScore.ref: ByteTrack's track_thresh is 0.6 for YOLOX; re-derived for this detector as its F1-optimal point on coco128 (detection.json fast.scoreThreshold).

lowScore.purpose: Detections between lowScore and highScore are used only in the second association, to keep partly occluded or blurred objects tracked.
lowScore.ref: ByteTrack low floor 0.1 transferred by matching precision (detection.json fast.lowScoreFloor).

newTrackScore.purpose: Minimum score for an unmatched detection to start a new track.
newTrackScore.ref: ByteTrack uses track_thresh + 0.1; here the point where the fast detector's precision reaches 0.856 on coco128.

firstMatchIou.purpose: Minimum IoU between a Kalman-predicted track box and a high-score detection in the first association.
firstMatchIou.ref: ByteTrack match_thresh 0.9 on IoU distance (1 - IoU).

secondMatchIou.purpose: Minimum IoU in the second association with low-score detections (stricter, because low-score boxes are less reliable).
secondMatchIou.ref: ByteTrack byte_tracker.py: linear_assignment(dists, thresh=0.5) for detections_second.

unconfirmedMatchIou.purpose: Minimum IoU for matching a tentative (not yet confirmed) track.
unconfirmedMatchIou.ref: ByteTrack: linear_assignment(dists, thresh=0.7) for unconfirmed tracks.

fuseScore.purpose: Multiply IoU similarity by detection score in the first association so confident detections win ties.

duplicateIou.purpose: Two tracks overlapping more than this are duplicates; the younger one is removed.

lostBufferMs.purpose: How long a confirmed track survives without a matching detection before it is removed (the object 'left').
lostBufferMs.ref: ByteTrack track_buffer = 30 frames at 30 fps; converted to time because our frame rate varies (6-15 fps).

confirmHits.purpose: Consecutive matched detections before a new track is confirmed.
confirmHits.ref: ByteTrack activates a new track when it is matched again in the next frame (two observations).

tentativeMaxMisses.purpose: A tentative track missing this many frames is dropped immediately.
tentativeMaxMisses.ref: ByteTrack removes unconfirmed tracks that are not matched in the next frame.

kalmanStdWeightPosition.purpose: Kalman process/measurement noise for position, as a fraction of box height (1/20).

kalmanStdWeightVelocity.purpose: Kalman process noise for velocity, as a fraction of box height (1/160).

classCompatibility.purpose: Detections of a different class can continue a track if both classes share a COCO supercategory (e.g. cup/wine glass); the track label is decided by score-weighted voting.
classCompatibility.ref: Detectors mostly confuse similar categories (D. Hoiem, Y. Chodpathumwan, Q. Dai, Diagnosing Error in Object Detectors, ECCV 2012); supercategories come from COCO metadata via config/ontology.generated.json.
